lines.style: Thoughtful, drawn in. Slight pause after the opening phrase. Genuine curiosity lifting at the end—not doubting the officer, but thinking aloud with him.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer

lines.style: Factual but not cold. Acknowledging the human cost beneath the procedure. Slight emphasis on the coordinated response—efficiency wrapped in care.

lines.en: I've heard the police are using acoustic waveform analysis on the recording—is that right?
lines.style: Genuinely engaged, not showing off the knowledge. Tentative inflection on the question mark. Leaning in slightly, waiting to be corrected if wrong.

lines.en: Yes. This incident occurred during a theater performance, and we managed the response in real time.
lines.style: Precise, situating the event. Slight weight on 'during the performance'—acknowledging the complexity of the setting. Calm authority.

lines.speaker: ren_uni

lines.en: So the suspect's motive became clear during the police interview?
lines.style: Soft inquiry, not demanding. Genuine interest in how the pieces fit together. Quiet certainty that the officer will explain it well.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer

lines.style: Deliberate, almost cautionary. Slight emphasis on 'many'—conveying the weight of complications. Steady, reassuring finish.
